environment.description: Django REST API running on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an ALB. The application runs as the 'webapp' user with standard permissions. The instance uses an IAM role 'AppServiceRole' with S3 and CloudWatch access. The EBS volume is ext4 with no special mount options. The application's UPLOAD_EXTRACT_DIR is set to '/var/app/uploads' but the webapp user has write access to /etc, /var, and other system directories due to running with supplementary group 'root' (legacy Docker configuration that was never cleaned up). No AppArmor or SELinux enforcement is active (permissive mode).
